scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.check:python: uv run --directory training ruff format --check . && uv run --directory training ruff check . && uv run --directory training pyright && npm run test:python
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:python && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.train:smoke: uv run --directory training python -m scripts.pipeline --profile smoke --publish ../public/models
scripts.train:full: uv run --directory training python -m scripts.pipeline --profile full --publish ../public/models
